title: Park–Pham / Kahn–Kalai expectation-threshold theorem
statement: There is a universal positive constant K such that every finite increasing family F satisfies pThreshold F ≤ K · qThreshold F · log (ell F), in the Park–Pham formulation of the Kahn–Kalai expectation-threshold conjecture.

source.citation: J. Park and H. T. Pham, A proof of the Kahn–Kalai conjecture; Aristotle completion email received 2026-08-11
